scientific_question: Does adding backpropagated c_proj output-error geometry to post-GELU activation geometry identify task-useful output-side Givens coordinates that generalize across disjoint windows better than raw Frobenius, activation-only, or output-error-only selection?

volume_result.conclusion: Repairing the c_proj mean-log-singular deficit while preserving spectral shape worsened every fixed checkpoint, closing global volume as a causal explanation.

activation_only_result.conclusion: Activation-weighted angle fitting amplified correlated output coordinates and produced about 33x residual-stream error despite better first-order descent.

task_gradient_result.conclusion: Direct task-gradient pair selection won all eight finite-step cells but retained only 8.33 percent of its fit-gradient advantage on holdout.

moving_activation_frame_result.conclusion: Activation covariance alone omits the backpropagated task-error factor; the registered next missing discriminator is activation-error cross geometry.

shared_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in every arm

output_error_scale.source: RMS of the gradient of next-token CE with respect to each c_proj output channel on the fit window
output_error_scale.normalization: divide by the RMS across output channels, clamped below at 1e-30
output_error_scale.holdout_usage: scoring only; holdout output errors never alter pairs, scales, or angles

arms.frobenius_output32: select pairs from unprojected source and residual; fit ordinary Frobenius angles
arms.activation_selector_output32: select pairs from H_fit times source/residual; refit ordinary Frobenius angles on the unprojected matrices
arms.error_selector_output32: select pairs after multiplying source/residual output columns by bounded fit-window output-error RMS; refit ordinary Frobenius angles on unprojected matrices
arms.diagonal_kfac_selector_output32: select pairs from (H_fit times source/residual) with output columns multiplied by bounded fit-window output-error RMS; refit ordinary Frobenius angles on unprojected matrices

analysis.common_application: Apply the selected pairs with raw Frobenius angles to the unprojected c_proj transposed weight, transpose back, and apply decoupled weight decay once.

evaluation.primary: paired finite-step complete-model CE after simultaneous selected-layer updates on fit and holdout windows
secondary: fit and holdout task-gradient predicted CE decrease
fit and holdout post-GELU residual-output energy
output-error scale distribution and clamp fraction

common_requirements: all outputs, losses, gradients, activations, output errors, scales, and updates are finite
the matched acquisition identities and hashes are exact
all arms use exactly 147456 coordinates per selected layer
all arms use raw Frobenius angles and identical decay ordering
decision_rule.pass: Select the first arm in smallest-pass order that clears every common and candidate rule. A pass authorizes only production implementation and focused correctness/exact-resume tests, then one fresh exact-config MFU preflight at or above 20 percent.
decision_rule.fail: Close diagonal activation-error/Kronecker selector geometry and do not launch a causal run. Return to the accepted c_fc-only partial replacement while designing a qualitatively new c_proj generator.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update oracle; any passing production training path requires a separate exact-config MFU gate before launch
